blocks.summary: China tipped to 'step forward' as Woodside exits Timor-Leste gas project. An analyst predicts China will swoop in to help Timor-Leste develop its long-planned Greater Sunrise oil and gas project after Woodside sells its stake. Dementia deaths in Australia surpass one in 10 of all fatalities. The Australian Bureau of Statistics says it is the first time the deadly condition has accounted for more than 10 per cent of all Aussie deaths.
